# `PropertyViolationException`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\PropertyViolationException`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/PropertyViolationException.php#L18) — **Version:** working tree

**Extends:** `RuntimeException`

**Implements:** `Stringable`, `Throwable`

Reported when a property is falsified.

Carries the [`CounterExample`](/api/classes/CounterExample) so reporters (and tests of this package)
can inspect the seed and the shrunk arguments. Its message renders a
human-readable summary.
